execution_scope: Three validations on passive funded source net-NAV-interest allocations. Native derivative execution scaling, additional investor dealing/management fees and aggregate market capacity are not validated; source cost models remain tied to original actual native quantities.
dependence: Homothetic cells have different raw funded capital/NAV amounts but same source exposure ratio and normalized returns, not independent market evidence. All results share the same source historical paths.
limits: No stable live profit, independent future test, new native executions, fund-share dealing market, DSR/PBO correction or aggregate capacity claim. Original SMA and prospective singleS28/paper10 unchanged.
